title: ATC Communication - Audio 2
text: ATC Communication - Audio 2 Audio 2.mp3 Tell me the summery of this conversation : On the evening of Saturday, November 19, 2022, at Chicago O'Hare Airport, Envoy Air flight 3556, operated on behalf of American Eagle, was preparing to depart for Columbus, Ohio. The flight deck had Captain in training Patrick Ford in the left seat and Line Check Airman Captain Brandon Hendrickson in the right seat. Patrick Ford was the designated pilot flying that night.As the aircraft was taking off, a tragic incident occurred: Captain in training Patrick Ford lost consciousness. Recognizing the emergency, Captain Brandon Hendrickson swiftly took control of the aircraft. He communicated with the air traffic control (ATC) to relay the situation and requested an immediate return to O'Hare.Throughout the ordeal, the ATC provided guidance and support, ensuring the aircraft could land safely. Once on the ground, the incapacitated Ford had to be moved from the left seat, as standard procedures require the captain to maneuver the aircraft on the ground. An off-duty American Airlines pilot on board assisted Captain Hendrickson by managing communications with the ATC.Despite the efforts of paramedics who met the aircraft at the gate, Captain in training Patrick Ford tragically passed away. The video concludes with a message from Rick Wilson, the vice president of flight operations at Envoy Air, who expressed deep sadness over the loss and gratitude to Captain Brandon Hendrickson for his leadership and professionalism during the crisis.
